LESSON: USES OF DOMESTIC ANIMALS

Grade: Grade 4
Subject: AGRICULTURE
Strand: Food Production Processes
Topic 2.3: Uses of Domestic Animals

SECTION 1: WELCOME

Hello! Today we learn about Uses of Domestic Animals. Read the explanation, study the examples, do the practice, then try the revision quiz.

Big question: How do domestic animals contribute to food production?

SECTION 2: WHAT YOU WILL LEARN

By the end of this lesson, you will be able to:

1. identify types of domestic animals in the community

SECTION 3: LEARN STEP BY STEP

1. identify types of domestic animals in the community
   In simple words: practise until you can identify types of domestic animals in the community. Use examples from school and home in Kenya.

SECTION 4: EXAMPLES

Example 1: Talk about Uses of Domestic Animals using something you see at school in Kenya.

Example 2: Give a home example from your county, estate, or village.

Example 3: Teach a younger child one idea from this lesson in simple words.

SECTION 5: TRY THIS

1. Underline two new ideas about Uses of Domestic Animals in the examples.
2. Explain Uses of Domestic Animals to a parent using one local example.
3. Draw or write three things that show you understand Uses of Domestic Animals.
4. Show that you can: identify types of domestic animals in the community

SECTION 6: WORK TO DO (PRACTICE & REVISION)

1. Write five sentences about Uses of Domestic Animals using examples from school or home.
2. Answer: Why is Uses of Domestic Animals important for a Grade 4 learner?
3. Make a one-minute oral presentation to a parent or teacher.
4. List three ways you will practise this topic this week.

SECTION: REMEMBER

1. identify types of domestic animals in the community

Now complete the Revision Quiz. Open the Answers tab only after you finish.

— CBC Learn · Original learner lesson from KICD outcomes (Strategy 2)
